channel.title: Crochet Baby Gifts
channel.description: Free crochet patterns and guides for handmade baby gifts and small bags.

item.title: Crochet Baby Socks: Free Easy Pattern in Three Sizes, 0 to 12 Months
item.description: Our own free crochet baby socks pattern, worked toe-up in the round in single crochet with an afterthought heel and a ribbed cuff. Three sizes sized to our bootie size chart and measured infant ankles, every round checked, and a Spanish video tutorial for a different sock.

item.title: Crochet Baby Dress With a Round Yoke: Free Pattern, 3 to 12 Months
item.description: Our own free pattern for a crochet baby dress with a round yoke, worked from the neck down: a double crochet yoke with two white V-stitch stripes, cap sleeves, a lattice skirt and a white scalloped hem. Three sizes, every round checked, and a neckline sized to pass over the baby's head.

item.title: What Is Amigurumi? A Plain-English Guide
item.description: What the word means, the five conventions that make amigurumi different from ordinary crochet, the US/UK terminology trap that ruins first attempts, and whether it makes a good baby gift.

item.title: Crochet Santa Ornament: Free Pattern for a Flat Santa Face
item.description: Our own free pattern for a flat crochet Santa ornament: a round face, a scalloped white beard, a red hat with a white brim, a mustache, a bobble nose and a hanging loop. Small, quick and worked flat, with every round and row checked.

item.title: Crochet Puff Flower: Free Pattern for a Six-Petal Flower Appliqué
item.description: Our own free pattern for a crochet puff flower: a two-round centre in one colour and six fat puff stitch petals in another, about 5 cm across in DK yarn. Every round checked, for blankets, bags, hair clips and gift wrap.

item.title: Crochet Snowman Amigurumi With a Top Hat: Free Pattern
item.description: Our own free pattern for a little crochet snowman in a black top hat with a red band and a striped green scarf. The body and head are one piece, so there is no neck seam. Every round counted and checked, with sizes, yarn amounts and baby-safe choices.

item.title: Crochet Mesh Hobo Bag: Free Pattern With Puff Stitch Columns
item.description: Our own free pattern for a crochet mesh hobo bag in 2 mm macrame cord: an oval base, open mesh rounds with a raised puff stitch column down each side, a band that draws the mouth in, and two straps that join into one hobo handle. Every round checked, with the cord worked out.

item.title: Crochet Rose With Stem: Free Pattern for a Long-Stem Rose With Leaves
item.description: Our own free pattern for a crochet long-stem rose: a closed centre, 12 wired petals in three sizes that curl open, a five-point calyx and two sprigs of three wired leaves on a wrapped wire stem. Every round checked, with the wire and yarn worked out.

item.title: Crochet Rose Bouquet: Free Pattern for Roses With Stems and Leaves
item.description: Our own free crochet rose bouquet pattern: nine rolled roses in red and cream, each on a wire stem wrapped in green yarn, with a five-point sepal and a leaf. Every row checked, with the yarn for each colour worked out.

item.title: Crochet Puff Stitch Bag: Free Pattern for a Striped Handbag With a Tassel
item.description: Our own free pattern for a crochet puff stitch bag in 2 mm macrame cord: an oval base, 16 rounds of puff stitch stripes in white, tan, mustard and brown, a brown band, a tube handle on two clasps and a tassel. Every round checked, with the cord worked out.

item.title: Crochet Layered Rose: Free Pattern for a Rose Appliqué and Brooch
item.description: Our own free pattern for a crochet layered rose: three layers of five petals, each worked behind the last on a small ring, and a rolled centre. One rose about 6 cm across in DK yarn, every round checked, for bags, brooches, hair clips and gift wrap.

item.title: Crochet Christmas Baby Booties With a Bow: Free Pattern in Red and Cream
item.description: Our own free pattern for Christmas crochet baby booties: a cream sole and rim, a red foot, a tall cream cuff of upright ribs and a green bow tied through the cuff. Three sizes from 0 to 12 months, sole lengths from our bootie size chart.

item.title: Ribbed Crochet Baby Booties With a Fold-Over Cuff: Free Pattern, 0 to 12 Months
item.description: Our own free pattern for crochet baby booties with a tall ribbed cuff that folds over at the ankle: an oval single crochet sole, a shaped toe and post stitch ribbing. Three sizes from 0 to 12 months, with sole lengths from our bootie size chart and every round checked.

item.title: Easy Crochet Baby Mittens: Free Thumbless Pattern, 0 to 12 Months
item.description: Our own free pattern for thumbless crochet baby mittens, worked from the fingertips down in single crochet with a ribbed cuff. Three sizes sized to published infant hand measurements, every round checked, with no strings or small parts.

item.title: Crochet Mini Bag: Free Pattern for a Coin and Earbuds Purse With a Shell Flap
item.description: Our own free crochet mini bag pattern: a flat base, single crochet sides and a flap that ends in a row of shells, with a snap and two loops for a strap. Two sizes, one for coins and keys and one that fits an earbuds case, every row checked.

item.title: Handmade Baby Gift Safety Checklist (Before You Give It)
item.description: Four checks to make before you hand over a handmade baby gift: small parts, cords, sleepwear flammability and safe sleep, each tied to the standard it comes from. Three practical checks follow.

item.title: Easy Crochet Drawstring Pouch: Free Beginner Pattern in Three Sizes
item.description: Our own free crochet drawstring pouch pattern for beginners: a flat base, double crochet sides and a crocheted cord with a bow. Mini, Small and Medium sizes in DK cotton, every round counted and checked, with a beginner video for each stitch.

item.title: Crochet Pouch Clutch With a Hidden Frame: Free Pattern in Three Frame Sizes
item.description: Our own free pattern for a pleated crochet pouch clutch on a hidden clasp frame: a flat base, single crochet sides, two pleats a side worked out from the frame, and single crochet over the frame bar. Sizes for 20, 25 and 30 cm frames in 2 mm macrame cord, with two video tutorials.

item.title: Crochet Phone Bag Pattern: A Free Crossbody Bag Sized to Fit Your Phone
item.description: Our own free crochet phone bag pattern in DK cotton: an oval base, a crossed double crochet texture, a button tab that keeps the phone in, and a crossbody strap. Two sizes worked out from real phone sizes in a case, with every round counted and checked.

item.title: Little Crochet Snowman in a Mug: Free Amigurumi Pattern
item.description: Our own free pattern for a little crochet snowman sitting in a red mug, with a Santa hat, holly, a striped scarf and embroidered snowflakes. The snowman grows straight out of the mug, so there is no seam to sew. Every round counted and checked, with sizes and baby-safe choices.

item.title: How to Soften a Stiff Crochet Blanket
item.description: Diagnose why the blanket is stiff before you try to fix it — three different causes need three different fixes, and one of them cannot be fixed at all.

item.title: Baby Clothing Measurements for Handmade Gifts (Chest, Length, Head)
item.description: Chest, back length, cross back and sleeve measurements by age, how much ease to add so the garment actually fits, and why sizing for the age is the mistake.

item.title: How to Plan Yarn for Each Colour in a Striped Baby Blanket
item.description: Work out yarn for each blanket colour with a swatch-based example, a per-colour shopping table and whole-ball rounding. Includes border and finishing allowances.

item.title: Hypoallergenic Yarn for Babies With Sensitive Skin
item.description: Why fibre thickness matters more than fibre type, what the word hypoallergenic legally means on yarn (nothing), and the two certifications that are actually checkable.

item.title: What to Write on a Handmade Baby Gift Tag
item.description: How to write a gift tag for a handmade baby present — the three things it must carry, why the care line matters most, and wording to borrow when nothing comes to mind.

item.title: Crochet Rose Car Charm: Free Pattern for Your Rearview Mirror
item.description: Our own free pattern for a crochet rose car charm: one rolled rose, a rosebud and two leaves on a slip-stitch cord that hangs from the mirror with a lark's head knot. Stitch counts for every row, sizes, and a free printable PDF.

item.title: Baby Mandrake Crochet: A Step-by-Step Project Guide
item.description: Follow the Baby Mandrake build with clear round tables, assembly checkpoints and yarn planning. Adapted from Mrs. Crowlet's pattern, with designer credit.

item.title: How to Present a Handmade Baby Blanket as a Gift
item.description: How to wrap, label and hand over a handmade baby blanket so it gets used rather than stored — including the one sentence on the tag that removes the recipient's biggest hesitation.

item.title: Sunflower Crochet Bunny: A Project Planner for Yarn, Colour and Finishing
item.description: Plan a sunflower crochet bunny with a yarn checklist, three colour recipes, ear comparison tips and finishing checks. Includes links to designers’ bunny patterns.

item.title: Easy Crochet Baby Hat for Beginners: Free Pattern in 5 Sizes, Preemie to 12 Months
item.description: A top-down half double crochet baby hat in five sizes, preemie to 12 months: the stitch count for every round, a lay-flat width check before the sides, and a stretchy ribbed brim. Worsted yarn, 50 to 125 yards.

item.title: How Long Does It Take to Crochet a Baby Blanket?
item.description: Realistic hours to crochet a baby blanket by size, yarn weight and stitch, how to work out your own speed in ten minutes, and how far ahead of a due date to start.

item.title: How to Store Handmade Baby Keepsakes So They Last
item.description: How to store a handmade baby blanket or first booties for decades — what actually destroys textiles in storage, why the plastic box in the loft is the worst option, and a method that costs almost nothing.

item.title: Baby Bootie Size Chart: Sole Length by Age
item.description: Sole length in inches and centimetres by age for handmade baby booties, how to measure a foot that will not hold still, and the two design features that decide whether booties stay on.

item.title: How to Crochet a Baby Blanket for Beginners: Free Pattern in Four Sizes
item.description: Your first crochet baby blanket in half double crochet, step by step: how many to chain from one swatch, the same stitch count on every row, a single crochet border counted for every side, and three checks before you frog uneven edges. Four sizes, three yarn weights.

item.title: Cotton vs Acrylic vs Bamboo Yarn for Baby Items
item.description: A straight comparison of the three most common baby yarns on warmth, breathability, washability, drape, cost and durability — and which one to choose for each specific item.

item.title: Easy Crochet Baby Booties in Four Sizes: A Round-by-Round Guide
item.description: Craft & Crochet's easy baby booties written out round by round for newborn, 0-3, 3-6 and 6-12 months: an oval half double crochet sole, a shaped toe and a straight ankle, with every stitch count and video timestamp.

item.title: Baby Hat Size Chart by Age (Preemie to 3 Years)
item.description: Head circumference and hat height by age for handmade baby hats, how much negative ease to use so the hat actually stays on, and why the age on the chart is the least reliable number in it.

item.title: Baby Blanket Color Combinations: Palettes That Work and How to Choose
item.description: Nine baby blanket colour palettes in one table, plus the checks most guides skip: will the stripes show, will the colours bleed, and what can a newborn see?

item.title: How to Crochet the Donatella Clutch: A Beginner-Friendly Tutorial
item.description: A step-by-step guide to Katy Handmade's Donatella crochet clutch: an oval base in single crochet, seven body rounds and a covered 19 cm spring closure, with video timestamps for every step.

item.title: Crochet T-Shirt Yarn Clutch Pattern: A Free Waistcoat-Stitch Clutch Built Around a 22 cm Snap Frame
item.description: A free crochet T-shirt yarn clutch pattern in waistcoat stitch, sized to a 22 cm clic-clac snap frame: a rectangular base worked in rounds, straight sides, and the frame crocheted into the top edge, with every stitch count worked out from gauge.

item.title: Machine-Washable Yarn for Baby Gifts: What to Look For
item.description: How to tell from a yarn label whether it will survive a real household wash — the four symbols that matter, what superwash actually means, and the words that mean the opposite of what you think.

item.title: Crochet Pencil Case Pattern: A Free Single-Crochet Zipper Case in Three Sizes
item.description: A free crochet pencil case pattern worked as one single-crochet rectangle: three sizes with exact zipper lengths, finished sizes and yarn estimates, plus the two steps that decide whether it comes out neat.

item.title: Yarn Weight Chart for Baby Projects (0–7, and What Each One Is Good For)
item.description: The full standard yarn weight system from lace to jumbo, with the hook size and gauge for each — and which weights actually suit baby blankets, hats, booties and toys.

item.title: What to Give at a Baby Shower When You Can't Crochet
item.description: How to give a handmade-feeling baby shower gift without making one — what new parents actually run out of, what gets quietly returned, and how to make a bought gift feel personal.

item.title: The Best Yarn for Baby Blankets: Soft, Washable and Safe
item.description: How to choose yarn for a baby blanket — the four properties that actually matter, what each fibre does in a wash, and why the softest yarn in the shop is often the wrong answer.

item.title: Is Acrylic Yarn Safe for Babies? An Honest Answer
item.description: Whether acrylic yarn is safe for baby blankets and clothes — the flammability question nobody addresses, the softness myth, and where the real concerns actually lie.

item.title: How to Wash a Crochet Baby Blanket Without Ruining It
item.description: How to wash a handmade crochet baby blanket by fibre — machine settings, what stretches it, how to dry it flat, and the two mistakes that cause permanent damage.

item.title: How Much Yarn for a Baby Blanket? Yardage by Size and Yarn Weight
item.description: Estimate yarn for a crochet baby blanket by size, yarn weight and stitch — with the square-inch method that lets you work out any size yourself, not just the ones on the chart.

item.title: Crochet or Knit for Baby Gifts? How to Choose
item.description: The real differences between crochet and knitting for baby items — speed, fabric, stretch, yarn use and which is easier to learn — with a straight recommendation for each project.

item.title: Crochet Hook Size Chart: US, UK and Metric Conversions
item.description: Every crochet hook size converted between metric, US letter-number and old UK numbering — plus why the US letters are not reliable and the millimetre figure is the only one to trust.

item.title: Crochet Baby Blanket Size Chart: Every Size, Newborn to Toddler
item.description: The standard crochet baby blanket sizes in inches and centimetres, from preemie to toddler — plus the one measurement that actually matters and why the charts disagree.

item.title: Are Crochet Blankets Safe for Babies to Sleep With?
item.description: The direct answer on crochet blankets and infant sleep, what current safe-sleep guidance actually says, and how to give a handmade blanket that gets used safely.
